annotations.title: Run a handler of an app

description: Runs one query, mutation or action of a deployed app and returns its result and the log lines it wrote, so you can test what you deployed. It runs as the connected person (as: "me", the default), never as anyone else; as: "guest" runs it as a guest visitor and only works on public apps. On a preview deployed without an account every call runs as one guest. Mutations and actions change real data. Only for apps the person owns or administers.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

args.description: Arguments: an array of positional values, or one object for handlers that take an object (tool handlers). Default: no arguments.

as.description: Who the handler sees in ctx.auth. Default "me".

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

kind.description: Which kind of handler name is.

name.description: Handler name as declared in server/index.ts.

name: call_app
title: Run a handler of an app
